default_rules.name: Tests are approved by the operator
AI diagnostics on prod are confirmed first
Operator read-only runs need no extra confirmation
Anything that changes a system is confirmed
Destructive changes are confirmed by typing the tool id

rules.name: Tests are approved by the operator
AI diagnostics on prod are confirmed first
Operator read-only runs need no extra confirmation
Anything that changes a system is confirmed
Destructive changes are confirmed by typing the tool id

access_policy.yaml:
rules:
- name: Tests are approved by the operator
  match:
    run: test
  decision: confirm
- name: AI diagnostics outside prod
  match:
    actor: ai
    effect: read_only
    nodes: env!=prod
  decision: allow
- name: AI diagnostics on prod are confirmed first
  match:
    actor: ai
    effect: read_only
    nodes: env=prod
  decision: confirm
- name: Operator read-only runs need no extra confirmation
  match:
    actor: operator
    effect: read_only
  decision: allow
- name: Anything that changes a system is confirmed
  match:
    effect: mutating
  decision: confirm
- name: Destructive changes are confirmed by typing the tool id
  match:
    effect: destructive
  decision:
    confirm: typed
